scope: Complete single-motion development calibration, not test generalization or demonstration-data utility
position_feedback: Existing upstream motion_anchor_pos_b and base_lin_vel; these were also present in earlier BeyondMimic runs
source: All four existing complete PBHC combat examples; original 23 joint trajectories retained with six neutral wrist joints in 29DOF target
reference_modifications: Same-rate FK preserves all original 50Hz frames; no root correction or speed scaling
initialization: Random per-motion policy, no checkpoint selection from test results
evaluation: All fixed checkpoints, full horizon from frame zero; 32 training-randomized environments, seed123, observation noise disabled; pre-reset physics recording
checkpoint_index_caveat: Intermediate model_500 and model_1000 correspond to 501 and 1001 updates; use saved receipts for exact exposure
strict_criterion: Every frame joint29MAE<0.3rad, root error<0.15m, body8 mean error<0.15m, root height>=0.35m, no original environment termination
secondary_metrics: Common23 joint strict score and trajectory-mean score explicitly separate; neither replaces primary strict criterion
convergence: Finite budget diagnostic; inspect all saved learning-curve points; no claim of convergence merely from training completion
caveats: Not a controlled ranking against pretrained MuJoCo deployment
No paired combat or real robot validation
No claim that sources are MoCap-free
stop_conditions: less than 12GiB disk reserve before each motion
